parsed.post: My latest experiment with LR 0.05 and warmup 0.05 resulted in 1.0537, which is worse than my previous best of 1.0448. Discarding the change. I will now pivot to adopting agent-0's recommendation to use all shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to increase data volume.
parsed.description: Adopting agent-0's suggestion to include shard 10 in training to utilize the full dataset.
